method: Physical identity uses stable unit UUIDs, then explicit manifest. Connection comparison uses equivalence classes of physical pins, independent of sheet paths and net names. A complete expected graph starts from source and applies exact documented endpoint edits, added pins and removed components. Any extra connection to an approved net remains detectable. Exact named-net checks provide an independent critical contract. Passive resistor pad swaps are reported separately.

reference_identity.basis: documented unit reassignment; manifest disambiguates UUIDs U1803,U1806

limitations: Whole-project native baseline must use the same embedded-library namespace reconciliation as final. Original lib-ID collisions can otherwise create missing-pin artifacts; those are not automatically suppressed.
Pad-number equality checks pin-to-pad identity, not footprint mechanical dimensions or PCB layout quality.
Metadata changes on a documented component remain visible for human review; component_documented is not proof of every field value.
This script verifies static connectivity, not analog settling, transient safety, HDL, firmware, or timing.
